# UjenziLink

> UjenziLink is an independent construction oversight and project review service for homeowners, diaspora builders, and small developers in Kenya. We verify construction site progress, document risks, and provide payment recommendations — without ever holding client funds, contracting work, or replacing licensed engineers or legal advisors.

## Key Facts

- UjenziLink does NOT hold, receive, or manage client funds at any point.
- UjenziLink is NOT a construction contractor, builder, or materials supplier.
- UjenziLink is NOT affiliated with any contractor, supplier, or construction firm in Kenya.
- UjenziLink does NOT replace a licensed structural engineer or legal advisor.
- UjenziLink's core service is the "Project Review": an independent site visit, evidence-based written report, and clear payment recommendation (hold, release, or partial release).
- Service area: Nairobi and surrounding counties in Kenya, with expanding coverage.
- Typical turnaround: contact within 24 hours of intake; report delivered within 48 hours of the site visit.

## Pricing (as of 2025)

- Project Review (one-time): Ksh 8,500
- Stage Oversight (per construction stage): Ksh 6,500
- Monthly Oversight (subscription): Ksh 18,000/month
- Premium Project Control: custom pricing, bespoke scope

## Who It's For

- Diaspora Kenyans building property while living abroad
- First-time homeowners building in Nairobi or surrounding counties
- Families managing multi-generational or jointly-owned construction projects
- Small developers overseeing rental or commercial construction projects
